messages:
liz (eng-sec): Heads-up — FinSecure sent their security questionnaire. High priority asks: BYOK/KMS integration, per-team RBAC scoping, 90-day audit log retention + export options, vuln disclosure/IR timeline, and SOC2 artifacts. Can we triage?

aj (infra): For Private/Dedicated we already support AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure KeyVault. Hosted API uses envelope encryption but we don’t offer customer-managed keys there today. We can propose Dedicated with KMS in the customer VPC. Also need new roles for finer RBAC (log_reader, kms_admin).

nina (solutions): Customer specifically wants separation between model management, billing, and log access. They asked for a mapping table showing which Redwood roles can do what.

dan (acct): They're asking for a security-review call next Tue 11am PT. Can we confirm SMEs for KMS + IR?

calendarbot: Event created — "FinSecure Security Review" Tue Jul 29 2025 18:00 UTC. Guests: liz (eng-sec), aj (infra), nina (solutions), dan (acct), pete (security).

aj (infra): Quick technical note: BYOK flow we can propose — customer supplies wrapped key, we store encrypted blob in metadata store, unwrap happens in HSM/KMS during model key unseal. Caveats: hosted multitenant path requires extra compliance review.

pete (security): We should include a sample RBAC policy snippet in the questionnaire. Suggested snippet:
```json
{
  "role": "log_reader",
  "permissions": [
    "logs:view",
    "events:query"
  ],
  "scope": "project:finsecure-prod"
}
```

sec-scan-bot: Vulnerability scan completed: 1 medium (CVE-2024-9999) in dependency xyz-lib; reproducible in staging. Recommend triage.

liz (eng-sec): Opened INF-4123 for the CVE and linked the scan. Assigned to @aj for patch/backport plan. Will note status in the questionnaire answer.

nina (solutions): For audit logs: we can stream to customer SIEM via HTTPS/syslog or S3 export. Default retention in-console is 90 days; we can provide export scripts for long-term retention. I'll draft export steps.

dan (acct): They also want our incident response playbook and SLA commitments (time-to-initial-notice, time-to-report). We can't share full internal playbook — can we provide a redacted version and sample timelines?

pete (security): Proposed high-level IR timeline to include in the doc: detection -> T+4h initial notification to customer (if impacted) -> T+24h containment summary -> T+48h interim report -> T+7d root-cause & remediation plan. Also include contact matrix and escalation path.

liz (eng-sec): Action items: 1) KMS BYOK feasibility + recommended customer-facing wording — @aj; 2) RBAC role mapping + sample policies — @pete; 3) Audit log export instructions + retention options — @nina; 4) Redacted IR timeline + contact matrix — @pete. Can folks ack and add ETA?

aj (infra): Ack — will have BYOK feasibility + caveats doc by Fri EOD.

nina (solutions): :thumbsup: I’ll draft export steps and sample syslog config by Monday.

dan (acct): Added to calendar and briefing doc. I'll push the questionnaire to them with a tentative delivery date after we have the drafts.

pete (security): On it — IR redact + RBAC samples by Monday.

liz (eng-sec): Thanks — I’ll assemble the questionnaire answers and share a first draft in #eng-security before Tue so we can rehearse the call.

liz (eng-sec): One more note — for SOC2 artifacts they asked for last audit date and point of contact. @pete do we have an exportable package we can share?

pete (security): Yes, we can provide a scoped SOC2 summary and auditor contact. I'll attach the redacted package to the draft.

liz (eng-sec): Great. Closing loop here — will post checklist and link to INF-4123 in the thread.
